# UX Checklist: System Audio Capture Pivot

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for visible recording state,
permission blockers, capture scope selection, degraded states, accessibility,
and user recovery copy.
**Created**: 2026-06-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements. Items test the requirements and design
artifacts, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are visible recording indicator requirements complete for active recording, degraded recording, stopping, failed, and blocked states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Contract §Capture Session]
- [x] CHK002 Are one-action Stop requirements complete for active recording and partial/failing capture states? [Completeness, Constitution §II, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK003 Are permission blocker requirements complete for microphone, Screen/System Audio, both missing, and revoked-during-recording flows? [Completeness, Spec §US2, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Are capture scope selection/confirmation requirements complete enough for app/window/display selection and recovery when the scope disappears? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Data Model §CaptureScopeApproval]
- [x] CHK005 Are degraded-state requirements complete for silent incoming audio, protected audio, missing frames, track misalignment, and CPU gate failures? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is user-facing language required to distinguish "recording blocked", "recording degraded", "recording saved", and "recording failed"? [Clarity, Spec §US2, Contract §Terminal Outcomes]
- [x] CHK007 Is the UI requirement clear that driver repair/reinstall must not be shown as the MVP fix for system-audio permission blockers? [Clarity, Spec §US2, Spec §US5]
- [x] CHK008 Are "approved scope" and "explicit degraded attempt" described clearly enough for non-technical users? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Are meter/status requirements clear that incoming/system audio levels must represent captured frames, not merely physical speaker activity? [Clarity, Spec §US3, Data Model §CaptureHealthSnapshot]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are UX requirements consistent with the constitution rule that active capture can never be invisible? [Consistency, Constitution §II, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Are readiness and recording states consistent with the pivot away from driver readiness and virtual-device repair? [Consistency, PRD §Desktop App, Spec §US5]
- [x] CHK012 Are UI state requirements consistent with manifest terminal outcomes so the UI cannot show success while the package is degraded or blocked? [Consistency, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
- [x] CHK013 Are recovery actions consistent across permission blockers, scope blockers, CPU gate failures, and protected audio states? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Quickstart §Permission Matrix]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for first-run onboarding or first-recording permission education without pretending the app itself grants OS permissions? [Coverage, Spec §US2, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK015 Are accessibility requirements defined for the recording indicator, Stop action, level meters, blockers, and scope picker? [Gap]
- [x] CHK016 Are localization-safe labels required for permission, capture scope, degraded, blocked, saved, failed, and no-HAL states? [Gap]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for small window sizes and long app/window/device names without truncating critical state meaning? [Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Are UX success criteria measurable enough to validate visible indicator, one-action Stop, blocker specificity, and truthful degraded state? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK019 Are UI requirements traceable to every P1 user story rather than only the happy path? [Traceability, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements explicit that UI text must not describe virtual devices as required for MVP recording? [Clarity, Spec §US5]
